allow_override_enabled.description: Allow .ftpaccess files in user directories to override config

allow_reconnect.description: Allow clients to reconnect after connection drop

auth_modules.description: List of auth modules to use (order matters)

chroot_enabled.description: Enable chroot jail for local users (standard security practice)

default_dir.description: Root directory for FTP sessions (e.g., for anonymous or non-chrooted users)

default_dir_allowed_user.description: User allowed access to default directory (for anonymous chroot)

default_dir_umask.description: Umask applied in the default directory

default_umask.description: Default UMASK for new files and directories (octal)

allow.description: true to allow, false to deny

host.description: Host pattern (IP, CIDR, or hostname substring)

ident_name.description: Server identification name used in FTP responses

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to (empty = all interfaces); supports IPv4 or IPv6

max_clients.description: Maximum total number of simultaneous clients allowed

max_clients_per_host.description: Maximum number of connections allowed from a single host

max_hosts_per_user.description: Maximum number of hosts one user may connect from simultaneously

max_login_attempts.description: Maximum failed login attempts before disconnection

max_user_per_host.description: Maximum number of connections per user per host

odbc_default_gid.description: GID to assign when no group info found in DB (nogroup)

odbc_default_uid.description: UID to assign when no user info found in DB (nobody)

odbc_enabled.description: Enable ODBC authentication and group lookup backend

odbc_get_group_info_query.default: SELECT group_name, gid, members FROM groups WHERE group_name='%G'
odbc_get_group_info_query.description: SQL query to fetch group info (supports %G for group placeholder)

odbc_get_user_info_query.default: SELECT login, password, uid, gid, shell, homedir FROM users WHERE login='%U'
odbc_get_user_info_query.description: SQL query to fetch user info (supports %U for username placeholder)

odbc_homedir_query.default: SELECT homedir FROM users WHERE login='%U'
odbc_homedir_query.description: Alternative SQL query to fetch user home directory only

odbc_password.description: ODBC database password (leave blank if using trusted auth)

server_name.description: Server name displayed to users (e.g., in '220' welcome message)

server_type.description: Whether the server runs as a daemon or under inetd/xinetd

system_log_path.description: Path to the system log file

timeout_linger.description: Seconds to wait during graceful shutdown before forced close

timeout_no_transfer.description: Seconds before disconnect if no data transfer (idle transfer timeout)

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for client cert verification (optional)

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS server certificate file

tls_cipher_suite.description: Allowed TLS cipher suites (modern, secure defaults recommended)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS (FTPS) support for encrypted connections

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS server private key file

tls_protocol.description: TLS versions to allow (minimum TLSv1.2 recommended)

tls_required.description: Require TLS for all connections (data and control)

transfer_log_enabled.description: Enable detailed transfer logging in xferlog format

transfer_log_path.description: Path to the transfer log file

virtual_hosts.description: List of virtual host blocks (one per domain or IP)

address.description: IP address to bind this virtual host to (optional)

anonymous_allowed_group.description: Group allowed to login anonymously (usually 'ftp' or 'anonymous')

anonymous_enabled.description: Enable anonymous login for this host

anonymous_path.description: Root directory for anonymous users (required if anonymous_enabled)

chroot.description: Chroot path (use ~ for home directory, or explicit path)

hostname.description: DNS hostname for this virtual host (e.g., 'ftp.example.com')

name.description: Display name in FTP responses (e.g., 'Example FTP Server')

port.description: Port to listen on for this virtual host (overrides global port)
